items.source:
#[must_use]
pub fn is_example_secret(secret: &str) -> bool {
    matches!(
        secret.trim(),
        "your-secure-secret-here"
            | "your-secure-secret"
            | "your-router-token-secret"
            | "your-secret-key"
            | "your-secret"
            | "your-admin-key"
            | "your-admin-secret"
            | "your-admin-key-here"
            | "your-token-admin-key"
            | "a-long-random-secret"
            | "example-shared-signing-secret"
            | "test-secret"
            | "change-me"
            | "changeme"
            | "replace-me"
            | "admin-secret"
    ) || crate::token_secret::is_placeholder(secret)
}
